description:
Create a voice Session: a short-lived, single-conversation
reservation that lets a client hold a live voice chat with your
agent. This is step 1 of 2. Creating the Session does not start any
audio on its own; it returns a `ws_url` that a client then connects
to over WebSocket to actually talk.

Call this endpoint from your server with your API key, and return
only the `ws_url` to your client. The API key must never reach the
browser. The `ws_url` is the only thing the client needs, and it is
safe to hand out because it is single-use and expires. For how to
connect and talk, see "Connect the client and talk" below the
request details.

(Tags: Sessions)

agent_id.description: ID of the agent the session talks to.

custom_variables.description:
Per-session variables that personalize the conversation.
Set server-side, so visitors cannot tamper with them.
Two reserved keys are read as instructions for this session
and never reach the agent: `__languages` and
`__post_call_actions`.

__languages.description:
Languages this session runs in, replacing the agent's
configured list. The first entry is the language the
visitor is greeted in. Send an array, or a pipe-separated
string such as `Hindi|English`.

allOf.description:
Side effects that fire once the call ends: email, webhook, Omni CRM,
Cloud WhatsApp, a workflow, Google Sheets, Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot
or Zoho Bigin.

mode.description:
Which input the dashboard shows for this placeholder. It
does not change the value sent: a `static_value` is used

static_value.description:
A fixed value for this placeholder. When set, it is used
instead of the extracted variable.

__post_call_actions.description:
Post-call actions for this session only, in the same shape
as `post_call_actions` on agent create. Email and webhook
only. They replace the agent's own post-call actions for
this session. Items that cannot be used are skipped and
listed in `post_call_actions_ignored`.

metadata.description:
Key-value pairs stored on the session for your own
tracking (e.g. CRM or lead IDs). Not shared with the
agent; echoed back as `metadata` in the post-call
webhook so you can correlate results with your records.

type.description: The session type. Only `voice` is supported.
